root_motivation: The operator discovers a broken main only when the next run's gate fails `cargo … --locked` (612's redrive, leg 20 "every `--locked` build rejects"), and the repair is a hand PR at 3 am. Leg 20 five whys, level 5: "Cargo.lock is a GENERATED artefact handled as a merged text file; and the gate validates the worktree, not the commit it pushes" — the land-side half is wm-build hand hotfixes (seed items 6, 7); this PRD is the repo-side half: the tree refuses a stale lock in a REQUIRED check. Evidence: `gh pr checks 178` shows `msrv check … fail 25s` beside `static analysis + core suites pass`; protection lists 2 of 10 job names.
user_persona: An agent (customer) that calls host.webhook_inbox.create once, pastes the url into a sender and shows its user the push event in the same session; the truth-tier integration_specialist persona whose gold is reachable in 4 calls; Operator Joe reading the digest.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a scratch copy of the workspace with the `semver` entry removed from `Cargo.lock` (the #178 squash shape), When `msrvlock_ac01` runs there, Then it fails quoting `cannot update the lock file`; Given the repo's own tree at the landing commit, Then it passes.

Given `ci.yml` at the landing commit, When the `--locked` parser test runs, Then every `cargo` `run:` line in jobs `gate` and `msrv` carries `--locked`; Given a fixture `ci.yml` with one `cargo test` lacking it, Then the test fails naming that line.

Given the workflow files at the landing commit, When `scripts/required-checks.sh --generate` runs, Then `.github/required-checks.toml` lists exactly 9 contexts — the 7 `ci.yml` jobs with `sandbox` expanded to `shard 1/2` and `shard 2/2`, plus `registry-manifest --check + schema validation` — and omits `publish to the MCP registry` (tag-only `if:`); no job name appears in the script.

Given a fixture protection JSON with `contexts` = the two current entries, When `--check` runs against it (`REQUIRED_CHECKS_JSON=<file>`), Then exit 1 naming the 7 missing contexts (incl. `msrv check …`); Given all 9, Then exit 0; Given 9 plus a stale extra, Then exit 1 naming the extra.

Given a fixture workflow dir where one job is renamed or a matrix gains a shard, When the toml-equals-generate test runs against the committed toml, Then it fails naming the differing context; Given the toml regenerated, Then it passes.

Given Joe or the operator runs `scripts/required-checks.sh --apply` after landing, When protection is read back, Then it lists all 9 contexts and `--check` exits 0 (Live; evidence: `gh api repos/j0yen/mcphost/branches/main/protection --jq '.required_status_checks.contexts | length'` prints `9`)
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred -- operator-provisioned: Joe/operator runs scripts/required-checks.sh --apply after landing (needs repo admin); evidence is the live protection read-back.

additional.signup_is_not_remembered: R3 says signup or host.redeem, but tests/sessbind_* pin signup followed by key-less behavior; only host.redeem is recorded (AC4's own scenario).

five_whys_trace.q: Why did the 10-09 webhook-inbox session make seven calls and never publish?
five_whys_trace.a: The recipe was three host steps with the hook URL only in step 2, and key-less quickstart answers repeated after a successful redeem.

five_whys_trace.q: Why did a key-less call after redeem not work?
five_whys_trace.a: /mcp is stateless, so no session carries the redeem; the next key-less call implicit-signed-up a second tenant.

five_whys_trace.q: Why does the fix key on the peer?
five_whys_trace.a: IP + User-Agent hash is the only identity the stateless handler has across those calls; a 10-minute memory turns the second tenant into a named refusal.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Peer hash = IP+UA or IP only?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: IP+UA (the PRD default), hashed; recorded in the PR.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Which quota gates create: event_triggers_max or schedules_max?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Both are checked before anything is created; event_triggers_max counts event + message + webhook triggers, so the free plan's 3 trips plan_limit first (data.limit 3).
